== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Energizing Wind]].
* Can be combined with [[Quickening Zephyr]] to reduce the recharge cost introduced by this skill.
* If affected by both Energizing Wind and Quickening Zephyr, 10 and 15 energy skills are cheaper with Energizing Wind applied last, while 25 Energy skills are cheaper if Quickening Zephyr is applied last.
* The effects of [[Expertise]] are calculated after the effects of Energizing Wind.

== Trivia ==
